not_claimed: No symbol is asserted to be reachable from gameplay code; this file only states the native numeric value.
Tables whose native body mixed index slots with named slots (the 11 END sentinels) are not normalised into symbols.
policy: Read-only symbol authority. Resolving a symbol never grants capability or changes behaviour; a caller must still have an explicit native reason to use the number.
provenance: Native client Enum chunk, lifted verbatim. Every entry is a literal integer; the 11 non-integer entries are C-enum END sentinels emitted as {"global": <NAME>} and are kept unmodified under "opaque" rather than given an invented numeric value.
